ambiguities.question: Does B68 already rule this out?
ambiguities.resolution: No. B68 covers independent global rational-function scalar circuits; B69 is finite-subgroup, target-local, and permits explicitly charged transposition and subgroup-coordinate algebra.

ambiguities.question: Does Boolean membership alone solve ECDLP?
ambiguities.resolution: No. B69 requires charged shift search, H-restricted discrete-log recovery, sign resolution, and final scalar verification.

candidates.dominated_by: Pollard rho unless beta<1/2 and every setup, memory, data, recovery, success, and retry term is established
